summary: Frontend-only end-to-end validation of the new V3Cube-parity Admin App Settings page and the wired 'allow_driver_edit_profile' driver-side gate. All 5 review-request flows passed.

tests_executed.name: Admin login + /admin/app-settings renders
tests_executed.details: admin-app-settings-page visible; title 'Paramètres généraux'; save btn, search box, both tabs (general+app) visible.

tests_executed.name: Général tab grouped cards
tests_executed.details: 3 groups present: settings-group-Identité & branding, settings-group-Localisation & affichage, settings-group-Maintenance & liens.

tests_executed.name: App Settings tab grouped cards
tests_executed.details: 10 groups: Réservation & course, Destinations/arrêts & Pool, Dispatch, Chauffeur/Prestataire, Accessibilité, Tarifs & frais, Pourboire, Récompenses & parrainage, Fonctionnalités, Sécurité & vérification. setting-allow_driver_edit_profile, setting-taxi_hail_option, setting-enable_pool, setting-driver_timeout all visible.

tests_executed.name: Search filter ('pool')
tests_executed.details: setting-enable_pool visible; setting-driver_timeout removed from DOM (count=0).

tests_executed.name: Save persists allow_driver_edit_profile=false
tests_executed.details: Set to Non, toast 'Paramètres enregistrés' shown, page reload retains false.

tests_executed.name: Driver gate hides row when disabled
tests_executed.details: Logged in as jean.dupont@demo.sb on /chauffeur/profile. 'Mes informations (societe, licence)' row absent (profile-row count=0).

tests_executed.name: Driver gate shows row + submit works when enabled
tests_executed.details: Row visible, driver-info-modal opens, info-company-input/info-license-input/info-submit-btn submitted; toast 'Demande envoyée — en attente de validation.' shown.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminAppSettings.js is 371 lines (OK). DriverProfilePage.js is 574 lines — borderline; consider extracting the InfoEdit and Services modals into separate components for maintainability.

Only the 'Mes informations' row is gated by allow_driver_edit_profile; the broader 'edit profile' surface (Gerer son compte, Changer le mot de passe, etc.) is currently a 'soon' placeholder, so no over-gating issue today, but document scope when more profile-edit features land.
Two console warnings about google.maps.places.Autocomplete deprecation (March 2025). Migrate to PlaceAutocompleteElement at some point; not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Driver info edit submitted SB Drive Test SARL / VTC-LIC-TEST-001 — pending validation (does not overwrite live data; sits in pending bucket).
final_setting_state: allow_driver_edit_profile = true (Oui) — left enabled as instructed at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AdminAppSettings page wired correctly: Général tab has 3 cards, App Settings tab has 10 cards (118 keys backing GET /api/config/app-settings). Save → PUT /api/config/admin/app-settings → public GET reflects change. Driver-side gate uses configAPI.getAppSettings() in DriverProfilePage and conditionally renders ProfileRow only when allow_driver_edit_profile !== false. Selects render 'true'/'false' as <option> values (display 'Oui'/'Non') — use .select_option('true' or 'false').
